reviewed_scope: Static review of the checked-out tree, git metadata, Go module graph, GitHub Actions workflows, CI/release files, and committed image assets. No runtime execution unless stated.

expected_build_time_network.trigger: go build / go run with a cold module cache
expected_build_time_network.notes: Integrity is enforced by go.sum. Check for a replace directive or a changed go.sum before trusting a build.
Pin actions by SHA where possible. Watch for pull_request_target, secrets in PR jobs, and fetch-pipe-to-shell.

notes: Baseline is a point-in-time snapshot, not a trust anchor. Re-derive it only after reviewing a diff.
Any new network import, remote host, exec sink, CI action, or binary asset is a review event.
The localhost-only constraint: any socket/packet/connection outside 127.0.0.0/8, ::1, or a Unix domain socket is a failing finding.
